text:
jess-sales: FYI — live demo with Clearwell just hit streaming issues. Their UI shows 'incomplete response' and JSON parse errors.
sean-clearwell: yep, during the demo it started spitting partial objects then dropped the connection. Happens ~10s after start.
jess-sales: timeline: started demo at :45, first partial chunk ~:53, disconnect at :55. No obvious error in the demo app console besides a parse error.
ryan-eng: can you paste the raw SSE chunks from the browser network tab or same from our proxy logs? need to see if delimiters are missing.
sean-clearwell: pasted a snippet in DM, but here's the sequence:
```
event: message
data: {"id":"1","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello"}}}
data: {"id":"1","choices":[{"delta":{"content":" world"}}}

# then socket closes abruptly
```
sean-clearwell: note the second data line is missing the closing `}` before the `\n\n`.
ryan-eng: that looks like a truncated chunk from the upstream model node — could be the kernel hit a SIGPIPE on write. checking host logs now.
tasha-sre: I see repeated `connection reset by peer` entries around the same timeframe in the dedicated pool: `tcp_read: connection reset` on worker-7. Also a couple of OOM-kill events 3m prior.
elena-ml: OOM could cause partial flushes if the runtime closed the stream mid-emit. Was this deployment using a quantized variant? Any recent rollouts?
dino-sdk: SDK note — client-side parser tolerates chunked text but expects each SSE event to end with a double newline. If the server sends partial event then closes, the client will throw parse error. We should either buffer until complete or ensure server streams full event boundaries.
ryan-eng: quick repro for infra: curl -N to our endpoint during the demo and capture raw output: `curl -v -N "https://api.redwood/test-stream?demo=clearwell" > raw.txt` — will show chunk boundaries.
sean-clearwell: ran that, attached raw.txt in DM. Headers show `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`. 
jess-sales: any immediate workaround we can give the customer so demo isn't blocked?
dino-sdk: short-term: in the web demo, catch JSON parse errors and retry once; combine partial buffers until 2 consecutive newlines seen. Not ideal but unblock demo.
tasha-sre: I'll roll a hotfix to the worker pool to increase memory headroom and disable a noisy cron that spikes allocations. Deploy bot will kick off after approvals.
deploy-bot: deploy started for infra/worker-pool @1890001302. Canary on 2 nodes.
ryan-eng: I'll add server-side guard to flush complete SSE events (ensure `\n\n` on each event) and retry on transient socket errors. Also adding a metric for `sse_truncated_events` so we can alert.
elena-ml: also flagging the model side — if generation process OOMs it may cause truncated outputs. Adding budget checks in the generation loop to avoid partial writes.
sean-clearwell: thanks — we'll try the client-side retry for the demo now. If you can share ETA on the infra fix that would help.
tasha-sre: hotfix ETA ~12 minutes; canary healthy so far. I'll post when canary completes.
jess-sales: appreciate the fast triage — I'll tell Sean to keep demo on hold for 15min and retry after we confirm canary.
sean-clearwell: ok re-scheduling the live audience for +30m. thanks everyone.
ryan-eng: follow-up action items: (1) server guard to ensure event boundaries, (2) metric + alert for truncated SSE, (3) increase worker memory headroom, (4) client-side graceful retry pattern added to our demo SDK docs.
dino-sdk: I'll open a small PR with the client retry snippet and link it in the sales playbook.
tasha-sre: can confirm canary completed @1890001372, no truncated events observed in 3 test runs.
jess-sales: perfect. I'll ping Sean and close the thread after he verifies demo success.
sean-clearwell: demo replayed cleanly after canary. No JS parse errors. Great work :rocket:
jess-sales: closing. Thanks team :heart:
